text: The US uses the phrase ‘**Speed Limit**’ on their speed signs.
The numbers on American speed signs are usually lower than on Canadian ones, since they use miles instead of kilometres. In addition, speed limits ending in 5 are more common in the US.
NOTE: [Canada](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYUCX62g3ENJct2A) uses the word ‘Maximum’ on their speed signs.
text_zh: 美國在速限標誌上使用「**Speed Limit**」這個詞組。
美國速限標誌上的數字通常比加拿大的低，因為他們使用英里而不是公里。此外，以 5 結尾的速限在美國更常見。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYUCX62g3ENJct2A)在速限標誌上使用「Maximum」這個詞。

text: Road signs in the US tend to use **more words** compared to their Canadian counterparts. A good example are railway crossing signs, which feature the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ on them. In Canada, these signs are typically blank.

This tendency is also noticeable on [yellow diamond warning signs](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6). In Canada, the words will usually be on a rectangular sign below the yellow diamond, which would have a diagram on it instead.
text_zh: 相較於加拿大，美國的道路標誌傾向使用**更多文字**。一個很好的例子是鐵路平交道標誌，上面直接印有「railroad crossing」字樣。而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是空白的。
這種傾向在[黃色菱形警告標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/ySfoRRrDjUqSRSub6)上也特別明顯。在加拿大，文字通常會位於黃色菱形下方的一個長方形標誌上，而菱形本身則會改用圖示。

text: The US uses **American English** spelling (e.g. center, color).

In addition, the US primarily uses the [imperial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units) for measurements. For example, speed and distance are measured in **miles**. You will also often see feet and inches on signs, indicating the height of bridges.

NOTE: This is useful to distinguish between the English-speaking parts of Canada, where British English spelling and (usually) the [metric system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system) are used. For example, Canada measures speed in kilometres.
text_zh: 美國使用**美式英語**拼寫（例如 center、color）。
此外，美國主要使用[英制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units)來進行測量。例如，速度和距離都是以**英里**來計算。你也會經常在標誌上看到用來標示橋樑高度的英尺和英寸。
注意：這有助於區分英語系的加拿大地區，因為當地使用英式拼法，且（通常）使用[公制系統](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system)。例如，加拿大是以公里來測量速度。

text: **Triangular yellow signs** with the phrase ‘No Passing Zone’ are exclusive to the US.
text_zh: 印有「No Passing Zone」字樣的**三角形黃色標誌**是美國獨有的。

text: These rectangular **junction signs** with a single or double arrow are found in the US.

NOTE: [Canada](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.7445702,-84.128801,3a,19.9y,168.72h,80.95t,1.15r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se1gQJA3H13DWO2lWqmbwAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) uses diamond-shaped junction signs.
text_zh: 這些帶有單箭頭或雙箭頭的長方形**路口標誌**常見於美國。
注意：[加拿大](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.7445702,-84.128801,3a,19.9y,168.72h,80.95t,1.15r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se1gQJA3H13DWO2lWqmbwAg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)使用的是菱形分流標誌。

text: American **yield signs** are shaped like an upside-down triangle with a red border, a white field in the middle and the word ‘YIELD’.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/zBwtzhBVjPgtw1628) yield signs look similar, but lack the ‘YIELD’ text.
text_zh: 美國的**讓路標誌**形狀像是一個倒三角形，具有紅色邊框、中間為白色底色，並印有「YIELD」字樣。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/zBwtzhBVjPgtw1628)的讓路標誌看起來很相似，但缺少「YIELD」文字。

text: American one-way signs are usually a **horizontal black rectangle** with a **white arrow** inside of it. These signs will also always have the words ‘ONE WAY’ printed on them. In cities, they are a white vertical rectangle with the words ‘ONE WAY’ on them and an arrow underneath.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/f9n6jHbEQJFrNY5e6) one-way signs are of the same shape and colour, but might not have the words ‘ONE WAY’ on them.
text_zh: 美國的單行道標誌通常是**橫向黑色長方形**，內部含有**白色箭頭**。這些標誌也一定會印有「ONE WAY」字樣。在城市中，它們則是印有「ONE WAY」字樣且下方帶有箭頭的白色直向長方形。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/f9n6jHbEQJFrNY5e6)的單行道標誌形狀和顏色相同，但可能沒有印上「ONE WAY」字樣。

text: White and orange **fibre optic cable markers** are almost unique to the US.
NOTE: On very rare occasions, they can be found in Canada.
text_zh: 白色與橘色的**光纖纜線標示牌**幾乎是美國特有的。
注意：在非常罕見的情況下，加拿大也能找到它們。

text: The US uses **yellow middle lines** and white outer lines. Double middle lines are the most common.
On divided roads, the outer line closest to the median will be yellow, and the other lines will usually be white.
NOTE: Double middle lines are less common in Canada, but not rare – use this meta with caution. Furthermore, yellow road lines are very rare in Europe.
text_zh: 美國使用**黃色中線**與白色外線。雙黃中線是最常見的。
在分向道路上，最靠近中央分隔帶的外線會是黃色的，其餘線條通常是白色的。
注意：雙中線在加拿大較少見，但也非絕無僅有——使用此特徵時請小心。此外，黃色道路標線在歐洲非常罕見。

text: Interstate highways, US highways, and some state roads have **rumble strips** on each edge of the road, which are small indentations in the pavement perpendicular to the road. These can be located on the outside edges of the road and in between lanes on multi-lane highways.
NOTE: Rumble strips may appear in Canada, but are much more rare.
text_zh: 州際公路、美國國道以及部分州道在道路的每一側邊緣都有**減速震動帶**，這是道路鋪面上垂直於路面的一系列小型凹槽。這些凹槽可以位於道路的外側邊緣，以及多車道公路的車道之間。
注意：減速標線可能會出現在加拿大，但非常罕見。

text: **Small, rectangular manufactured homes**, also known as mobile or ‘trailer’ homes, are popular in rural areas of the US. In general, mobile homes are more common in the Southeast, but they can be seen anywhere in the country.
NOTE: This style of home can sometimes be seen in Canada, but to a much lesser extent.
text_zh: **小型長方形組合屋**（也稱為移動房屋或「拖車」房屋）在美國鄉村地區很受歡迎。大體來說，移動房屋在東南部更為常見，但你在全國各地都能看到它們。
注意：這種風格的房屋有時也可以在加拿大看到，但數量少得多。

text: **Baptist churches** are very common in the United States. Similar to mobile homes, these are more common in the Southern Plains and Southeast United States, but can be found in all 50 states.
NOTE: Baptist churches are rare in Canada.
text_zh: **浸信會教堂**在美國非常普遍。類似於組合屋，這些教堂在美國南部平原和東南部更為常見，但在所有 50 個州都能找到。
注意：浸信會教堂在加拿大很罕見。

text: Large highways in the US use large, rectangular, **green metal signs** with curved edges and white text to mark highway exits, distances to nearby towns, and the names of upcoming roads (mainly in cities).
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/JBuxw1mVSSq1cRy37) highway signs have a similar appearance, but will typically have squared instead of curved edges.
text_zh: 美國的大型高速公路使用大型、長方形、邊緣帶有弧度且配有白字的**綠色金屬標誌**，來標示高速公路出口、附近城鎮的距離，以及前方道路的名稱（主要在城市中）。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/JBuxw1mVSSq1cRy37)的高速公路標誌外觀相似，但通常是直角邊緣而非圓弧邊緣。

text: Leading up to exits on large highways, you commonly see large, **blue rectangular signs** with white text, highlighting services, such as food, lodging and petrol, that are available at the upcoming highway exit.
NOTE: Canada uses [similar signs](https://goo.gl/maps/14FARb11GKUu4sBG6) on some of their highways.
text_zh: 在接近大型高速公路出口時，你經常會看到大型的**藍色長方形標誌**搭配白字，用來標示前方高速公路出口處提供的服務，例如餐飲、住宿和汽油。
注意：加拿大在其部分高速公路上使用[類似的標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/14FARb11GKUu4sBG6)。

text: **Generation 2** coverage is **rare** in the US. If you have a Generation 2 location in a North American setting, you are more likely to be in Canada.
The exception to this is Alaska, and to a lesser extent Hawaii, which have a fair amount of Generation 2. You can also rarely see Generation 2 in rural areas of the Deep South.
**Generation 3** coverage is also significantly less common than in Canada.
text_zh: **第 2 代**街景覆蓋在美國**非常少見**。如果你在北美地區看到第 2 代的街景，你更有可能是身處加拿大。
唯一的例外阿拉斯加，以及夏威夷（程度較輕），這兩地有相當多的第二代相機世代。在深南部（Deep South）的鄉村地區也很少見地能看到第二代相機世代。
**第 3 代**街景覆蓋也比加拿大少得多。

text: In addition to having less Generation 3 coverage than Canada, the side mirrors are also blurred out differently: While they generally appear as two peaks in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a **single peak** in the US.
text_zh: 除了第 3 代覆蓋比加拿大少之外，後視鏡的模糊處理方式也不同：加拿大第 3 代覆蓋中的後視鏡通常呈現兩個尖峰的形狀，而在美國你主要會看到**單一尖峰**。

text: **Parking indicator signs** in the US are typically white metal signs with red, green, or black text. They may include specific information about when you can park on said road, and arrows indicating where parking is (or is not) allowed.
NOTE: [Canadian](https://goo.gl/maps/WWt6d3SRhG4B61Q19) parking signs use similar styles and colours, but typically are less ‘wordy,’ instead using more symbols when applicable.
text_zh: 美國的**停車指示標誌**通常是印有紅、綠或黑字的白色金屬標誌。它們可能會包含關於何時能在該道路停車的具體資訊，以及指示哪裡可以（或不可以）停車的箭頭。
注意：[加拿大](https://goo.gl/maps/WWt6d3SRhG4B61Q19)的停車標誌使用類似的風格和顏色，但通常「字比較少」，在適用的情況下會使用更多符號代替。

text: This is an example of the most common type of **orange construction barrel** in the United States. They are made out of orange plastic with horizontal white stripes and a black rubber base. They are usually used to block off lanes to traffic during times of road construction.
text_zh: 這是美國最常見的**橘色施工用塑膠桶**範例。它們由橘色塑膠製成，帶有水平的白色條紋以及黑色橡膠底座。在道路施工期間，它們通常被用來阻擋車道以管制交通。

text: This style of **mailbox**, resting on top of a post and with a small flag on the side, is mostly associated with North America.
text_zh: 這種支撐在柱子上方、側邊帶有小旗子的**信箱**風格，主要與北美有關。

text: North America primarily uses **wooden utility poles**.
Several European countries also primarily use wooden utility poles. However, a concrete pole in particular is mostly associated with Europe.
In addition, the US and Canada use transformers that are **large metallic cylinders**. This will never be seen in European countries.
text_zh: 北美主要使用**木製電線桿**。
幾個歐洲國家也主要使用木製電線桿。不過，水泥電線桿特別容易讓人聯想到歐洲。
此外，美國和加拿大使用的變壓器是**大型金屬圓柱體**。這在歐洲國家絕對看不到。

text: This style of **insulator**, which is raised slightly **on top** of the utility pole, can be a good clue for the US and Canada. It is not typically found in Europe. It is especially apparent on simple poles with a single insulator.
text_zh: 這種稍微突起於電線桿**頂部**的**絕緣子**風格，可以成為美國和加拿大的良好線索。它在歐洲並不多見。這在只有單一絕緣子的簡單電線桿上特別明顯。

text: The United States and Canada will usually have **short license plates**. Europe usually uses a **long license plate** which will also have a blue strip on the side.
NOTE: Each state has its own designs. An overview of the specific designs in each state can be seen in step 2.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大通常使用**短車牌**。歐洲通常使用**長車牌**，而且側邊會有藍色條紋。
注意：每個州都有自己的設計。各州具體設計的概述可以在步驟 2 中看到。

text: In the US and Canada, especially at large intersections, **long metal bars** with **stop lights** attached to them hang over the street. These bars also commonly have street signs, highway signs, or other signs attached to them.
text_zh: 在美國和加拿大，特別是在大型路口，街道上方會懸掛掛有**紅綠燈**的**長金屬桿**。這些橫桿上也經常掛有路名牌、公路標誌或其他標誌。

text: Thin metal signposts are common. They will typically either have several small holes or have a [U-profile](/images/united-states/u-profile.jpg?).
text_zh: 細金屬路標很常見。它們通常要麼有幾個小孔，要麼具有 [U 型斷面](/images/united-states/u-profile.jpg?)。

text: North American semi-trucks have a **longer nose**, since the engine is in front of the driver’s cab. In contrast, European and Asian semi-trucks are cabovers, meaning the driver sits on top of the engine, giving the truck an **L shape**.

NOTE: This is only useful to differentiate between North America and Europe, as these trucks are found throughout all of the Americas. Australian and New Zealand trucks are typically a mix of the two.
text_zh: 北美半聯結車有著**較長的車頭**，因為引擎位於駕駛室前方。相比之下，歐洲和亞洲的半聯結車是平頭車，意思是駕駛坐在引擎上方，使卡車呈現** L 形**。
注意：這只對區分北美和歐洲有用，因為這些卡車在整個美洲都很常見。澳洲和紐西蘭的卡車通常是這兩者的混合。

text: Here are two common types of **water towers** seen in towns across the United States and Canada. They are typically very tall, and sometimes have the name of the town and state painted on them, so they can be useful for region guessing.
text_zh: 以下是美國和加拿大各地城鎮常見的兩種**水塔**。它們通常非常高，有時上面會漆上城鎮和州的名稱，因此對於地區猜測很有幫助。

text: **Generation 3** coverage in the US and Canada generally has **no visible antenna**. This can be helpful to distinguish it from Europe in low-info rounds. Some European Generation 3 coverage has no visible antenna, but most of it does.

There is an important exception: in national parks in the US, you can find a Generation 3 car with a [stubby antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/6nngRLvsmvVm7SPS8) with diagonal coils around it. Still, this specific type of antenna is not found in Europe.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大的**第 3 代**街景覆蓋通常**沒有明顯的天線**。在資訊較少的局數中，這有助於將其與歐洲區分開來。部分歐洲的第 3 代覆蓋沒有明顯的天線，但大多數都有。
有一個重要的例外：在美國的國家公園裡，你可以找到一台第 3 相機世代的車輛，其配備了帶有對角線線圈的[粗短天線](https://goo.gl/maps/6nngRLvsmvVm7SPS8)。不過，這種特定類型的天線在歐洲是找不到的。

text: Both the US and Canada also have Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. When the car isn’t blurred properly, you will usually see a mirror sticking out on the right side.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大也都有第 4 世代「smallcam」街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的第 4 世代低，並且下方有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有小凸起。該模糊也可能完全透明，使其更難察覺。當車子沒有被完美模糊時，你通常會看到右側凸出一個後視鏡。

text: Shown here is the population density of the United States. In general, areas east of the Missouri river are more densely populated than areas to the west.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這裡顯示的是美國的人口密度。總體來說，密蘇里河以東地區的人口密度比以西地區更高。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The US, as well as most of the Americas, uses short license plates, in contrast to longer European ones. Around half of the states also do **not require front plates**, which can also be useful in determining the state.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 美國以及多數美洲地區使用較短的車牌，這與較長的歐洲車牌形成對比。大約有一半的州也**不強制要求懸掛前車牌**，這對於判定美國各州也很有幫助。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Each US state has their own** unique license plate **design. Some of these are recognizable through the blur, and are thus worth learning.
text_zh: 美國每個州都有自己**獨特的車牌**設計。其中有些設計即使透過模糊處理也能辨認出來，因此很值得學習。

text: **Interstate Highways** are divided highways that often span large areas of the United States. Even-numbered Interstates run west to east, with the lowest numbers along the Gulf Coast and Mexico border. Odd-numbered highways run south to north, with the lowest numbers along the West Coast.

**US Highways** are also typically long roads that are sometimes (but not always) divided. The numbering system is generally the inverse of Interstate Highways, with low odd-numbered highways located along the East Coast and low even-numbered highways located close to the Canadian border in the north of the country.
NOTE: There are generally more exceptions to the US Highway numbering system than the Interstate Highway numbering system, in terms of placement.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **州際公路**是橫跨美國大片區域的雙向分隔公路。偶數編號的州際公路東西走向，最低的編號位於墨西哥灣沿岸和墨西哥邊界。奇數編號的公路南北走向，最低的編號則位於西海岸。
**美國國道**通常也是長途道路，有時（但非總是）為分隔公路。編號系統大致與州際公路相反，奇數編號較低的公路位於東海岸，而偶數編號較低的公路則位於該國北部的加拿大邊境附近。
注意：就位置而言，美國國道編號系統的例外情況通常比州際公路編號系統更多。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: US telephone numbers start with a three-digit **area code**. While these area codes are not clustered by initial digits, they are useful to learn.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 美國電話號碼以三位數的**區域號碼**開頭。雖然這些區域號碼並非按初始數字群聚，但很值得學習它們。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Each of the 50 states has its own **state flag**. These appear sometimes, but many of the more distinct looking flags will appear more often.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 50 個州各有其專屬的**州旗**。這些旗幟偶爾會出現，但許多外觀較具特色的旗幟會更常出現。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Shown here is a **topographic map** of the US.

Most significant elevation is in the west: here you will find large mountain ranges, but also more flat, high plateaus. Some parts have lower elevation: good examples are the [Central Valley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Valley_(California)) and [Imperial Valley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_Valley,_California) in California.

Elevation in the east is generally much lower. The most significant amount of elevation is found in the [Appalachians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Mountains), low mountain ranges running through the eastern and northeastern US. Good examples of hills in otherwise fairly flat regions are the [Driftless Area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Driftless_Area) in the Midwest, and [The Ozarks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozarks) in Missouri and Arkansas.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這裡顯示的是美國的**地形圖**。
最顯著的高海拔地區在西部：在這裡你會找到巨大的山脈，還有較平坦的高原。有些地區海拔較低：很好的例子是加利福尼亞州的[中央谷地](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Valley_(California))和[帝王谷](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_Valley,_California)。

東部的海拔通常低得多。最顯著的高海拔地形位於[阿巴拉契亞山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Mountains)，這是一條貫穿美國東部和東北部的低矮山脈。在其他方面相當平坦的地區中，丘陵的好例子包括中西部的[無冰磧區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Driftless_Area)，以及密蘇里州和阿肯色州的[歐扎克山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozarks)。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: This is a **forest density map** of the contiguous United States. Eastern and Northern regions of the country typically have much denser tree cover than Western and Southwestern regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這是美國本土的**森林密度圖**。該國的東部和北部地區通常比西部和西南部地區擁有密得多得多的樹木覆蓋。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Great Plains are in the middle of the United States and stretch from the Canadian border in the North, to central Texas in the South. This area is primarily **flat with few trees**. Some areas feature agriculture fields, while others feature dry and barren grassy fields.
text_zh: 大平原（Great Plains）位於美國中部，北起加拿大邊境，南至德州中部。這個地區主要為**地勢平坦且樹木稀少**。有些區域以農田為主，有些則是乾燥荒涼的草地。

text: The Appalachian mountain range is a low mountain range that runs through the eastern states. The general landscape consists of **low, forested mountains**, with beech and oak trees being a common sight.

NOTE: Houses in the south generally have [less storeys](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8). [New England architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76), commonly consisting of wood panelling, high roofs and a porch, is also more common toward the north, especially in New England.
text_zh: 阿帕拉契山脈（Appalachian mountain range）是一條貫穿東部各州的低矮山脈。整體景觀為**低矮且林木茂密的山區**，常見山毛櫸和橡樹。
注意：南方的房屋通常[樓層較少](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8)。[新英格蘭建築](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76)通常具有木製外牆、高屋頂和門廊，這在北方也較為常見，特別是在新英格蘭地區。

text: The area stretching from the Canadian border to Northern New Mexico is home to the Rocky Mountains. These jagged, rocky formations often feature many **pine trees** and **visible snow** all year round at the highest peaks. Some areas of the Rocky Mountain Range are noticeably [dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8), with few trees.
text_zh: 從加拿大邊境延伸至新墨西哥州北部的區域是洛磯山脈（Rocky Mountains）的所在地。這些鋸齒狀的岩石地形在最高峰通常有許多**松樹**，且全年都有**清晰可見的積雪**。洛磯山脈的某些地區明顯[乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8)，且樹木稀少。

text: The Great Basin, centred around Nevada, can be recognized by the tall, sometimes [snow-capped](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7) mountains in the background. There are dry, but grassy, and slightly **shrubby plains** leading up to the mountains.

The tallest mountains are in Nevada, Utah and California. More [gradual, rocky hills](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57) can be seen in Oregon, and [greener mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18) can be seen in Idaho and central Utah.
Keep in mind that there are exceptions, so make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 以內華達州為中心的大盆地，其特徵是背景中高聳且有時[覆雪](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7)的山脈。通往山脈的平原乾燥但長滿青草，且略帶**灌木叢生**。
最高聳的山脈位於內華達州、猶他州和加州。在奧勒岡州可以看到較為[平緩的岩石山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57)，而在愛達荷州和猶他州中部則可以看到[較為翠綠的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18)。
請記住凡事都有例外，因此在猜測之前務必留意其他線索。

text: Many parts of the Deep South, stretching from Oklahoma to South Carolina, have **reddish soil**. The exact tint of the soil can range from yellow to deep red.
text_zh: 從奧克拉荷馬州延伸到南卡羅來納州的深南部（Deep South）許多地區都有**帶紅色的土壤**。土壤的確切色調可以從黃色到深紅色不等。

text: The area spanning from the Montana Border with Saskatchewan to the Western Great Lakes features many ‘prairie potholes.’ These are areas of low-lying wetlands that feature **marshy grasses** and **small, shallow ponds**.
text_zh: 從蒙大拿州與薩斯喀徹溫省的邊境延伸至西部五大湖的地區，有許多「草原載波穴（prairie potholes）」。這些是低窪的濕地地區，帶有**沼澤草**和**小型淺水池**。

text: The **Nebraska Sandhills** are a recognizable region of rolling hills covered with prairie grass in the central-north part of the state.
text_zh: **內布拉斯加沙丘（Nebraska Sandhills）**是該州中北部一個辨識度很高、覆蓋著草原草的綿延沙丘地區。

text: In the Appalachian area stretching from southern New York to southern Virginia, there are a lot of forest-covered rolling hills, with **flat valleys** dividing them. A majority of the ridges are oriented Southwest to Northeast.
text_zh: 在從紐約州南部延伸至維吉尼亞州南部的阿帕拉契地區，有許多森林覆蓋的起伏山丘，並由**平坦的山谷**分隔開來。多數的山脊走向為西南至東北。

text: The Lower Mississippi River Valley is a **very flat** and open landscape with **red soil** in areas of Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Northeast Louisiana. Corn and other crops are common in this area.
text_zh: 下密西西比河谷（Lower Mississippi River Valley）是一個**非常平坦**且開闊的景觀，在田納西州、阿肯色州、密西西比州和路易斯安那州東北部的部分地區帶有**紅土**。玉米和其他農作物在該地區很常見。

text: **The** **Ouachita Mountains** stretch from Eastern Oklahoma into West-Central Arkansas. Unlike the nearby Ozark Mountains, these mountains are typically more steep in nature and easier to see from a distance.
text_zh: **瓦奇塔山脈（Ouachita Mountains）**從奧克拉荷馬州東部延伸至阿肯色州中西部。與鄰近的歐札克山脈（Ozark Mountains）不同，這些山脈通常本質上更為陡峭，從遠處也更容易看見。

text: The Southwest, centred around the Four Corners region of Utah, Arizona, New Mexico, and Colorado, features many **mesas** and **tablelands**. Often, these rock formations will be **red** in colour. Additionally, red soil is common in these areas.
text_zh: 以猶他州、亞利桑那州、新墨西哥州和科羅拉多州四角地區為中心的西南部，有許多**平頂山（mesas）**和**高原（tablelands）**。通常這些岩石地形會呈**紅色**。此外，紅土在這些地區也很常見。

text: Temperate rainforests are found in coastal areas of Washington, Oregon, and Northern California. These rainforests feature many **broadleaf trees, large conifers, and ferns.**
NOTE: These rainforests stretch north into coastal British Columbia and Southeast Alaska as well.
text_zh: 溫帶雨林分佈在華盛頓州、奧勒岡州和加州北部的沿海地區。這些雨林有許多**闊葉樹、大型針葉樹和蕨類植物。**
注意：這些雨林也向北延伸至英屬哥倫比亞省沿海和阿拉斯加東南部。

text: **Agricultural golden fields** can commonly be seen in eastern Washington.
NOTE: Flat areas of northern and eastern Oregon can have a similar appearance.
text_zh: **農業金色田野**在華盛頓州東部很常見。
注意：奧勒岡州北部和東部的平坦地區也可能呈現相似的外觀。

text: Central Valley, California can be recognized by its **Mediterranean climate**. This is reflected in its agriculture, seen in the vineyards and olive trees that can commonly be found here.
In addition, [rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6) can be seen toward the edges of the valley.
text_zh: 加州的中央谷地（Central Valley）可以透過其**地中海型氣候**來識別。這反映在其農業上，在這裡常見到葡萄園和橄欖樹。
此外，在谷地邊緣可以看到[起伏的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6)。

text: Just west of the metropolitan areas of Austin and San Antonio Texas lies a large area of dry, rocky hills featuring many **yucca** and **prickly pear** plants. [Texas Live Oak](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6) trees are the predominant tree type in this area.
text_zh: 就在德州奧斯汀和聖安東尼奧都會區的正西方，坐落著一大片乾燥的岩石丘陵地帶，長有許多**絲蘭**和**刺梨**植物。[德州櫟樹（Texas Live Oak）](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6)是該地區主要的樹種。

text: The Rio Grande Valley in South Texas is **extremely flat** and features **shrubby trees** and agricultural fields. This area borders the Mexican state of Tamaulipas.
text_zh: 德州南部的格蘭德河谷（Rio Grande Valley）**極為平坦**，且有**灌木狀的樹木**和農田。這個地區與墨西哥的塔毛利帕斯州接壤。

text: **Corn fields** can most commonly be found in these regions. For a detailed overview, see [this](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Corn_Belt_2018.svg) map.
text_zh: **玉米田**最常在這些地區找到。如需詳細概覽，請參閱[這張](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Corn_Belt_2018.svg)地圖。

text: **Soybeans** are short, dark green crops organised in long rows and are found in similar regions where corn is grown. They are most common in the Eastern Plains, Midwest, Lower Mississippi Valley, and areas of the Mid Atlantic.
text_zh: **大豆**是矮小、深綠色的作物，以長排方式排列，分佈在種植玉米的類似地區。它們在東部平原、中西部、下密西西比河谷和大西洋中部部分地區最為常見。

text: Along the Canadian border in North Dakota, and rarely Montana, fields filled with **short yellow canola flowers** (Brassica napus) can commonly be seen from the road.
text_zh: 在北達科他州沿著加拿大邊境，以及少數的蒙大拿州，從路上常能看到開滿**黃色油菜花（Brassica napus）**的田野。

text: **Cotton** is a crop that produces large fields of **fluffy white flowers**. It is most commonly produced in coastal Southeastern states, the Lower Mississippi River Valley, Western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona. You can click [here](https://ers.usda.gov/sites/default/files/_laserfiche/Charts/99698/CottonAcreage2017.png?v=95859) for a more detailed map.
NOTE: When cotton is not fully grown (earlier in the year) cotton fields often look like [this](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KfHaonkY71zhSDfe7).
text_zh: **棉花**是一種能長出大片**蓬鬆白花**田野的作物。它最常生產於東南部沿海各州、下密西西比河谷、德州西部以及加州和亞利桑那的部分地區。您可以點擊[這裡](https://ers.usda.gov/sites/default/files/_laserfiche/Charts/99698/CottonAcreage2017.png?v=95859)查看更詳細的地圖。
注意：當棉花尚未完全生長時（年份較早的時候），棉花田通常看起來像[這樣](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KfHaonkY71zhSDfe7)。

text: **Rice** production only occurs in a few areas of the US, so it is very useful for region guessing. It is typically grown in large, flat fields that resemble low prairies. It is only grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi River Valley in Arkansas, Louisiana, Texas, and Mississippi. You can click [here](https://ipad.fas.usda.gov/rssiws/al/crop_production_maps/US/USA_Rice.png) for a more detailed map.
NOTE: When rice is not fully grown, rice fields often look similar to [this](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e5TVrT3jBQg4Mgrb7).
text_zh: **稻米**生產僅發生在美國少數地區，因此對於地區猜測非常有用。它通常種植在類似低矮草原的大片平坦田野中。它僅種植在加州中北部以及阿肯色州、路易斯安那州、德州和密西西比州的下密西西比河谷。您可以點擊[這裡](https://ipad.fas.usda.gov/rssiws/al/crop_production_maps/US/USA_Rice.png)查看更詳細的地圖。
注意：當稻米尚未完全生長時，稻田通常看起來與[這個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/e5TVrT3jBQg4Mgrb7)相似。

text: The Eastern White Pine (_Pinus strobus_) has **horizontally layered branches** that gradually curve upwards at the ends, giving the tree a rather graceful appearance. They are common in New England, the northern Midwest near the Great Lakes, and the Appalachians.
NOTE: They can be found in eastern Canada as well.
text_zh: 東方白松（_Pinus strobus_）具有**水平分層的樹枝**，末端逐漸向上彎曲，賦予樹木相當優雅的外觀。牠們在新英格蘭、五大湖附近的中西部北部以及阿帕拉契山脈很常見。
注意：牠們也分佈在加拿大東部。

text: The loblolly pine (Pinus taeda), and longleaf pine (Pinus palustris), commonly referred to as **southern pines** in the community, are found throughout the southeastern US. They are a great way to recognize this region, as they are abundant, recognizable and mostly limited to this part of the country. They tend to be tall, with fluffy-looking clusters of pine needles.
text_zh: 火炬松（Pinus taeda）和長葉松（Pinus palustris），在社群中通常被稱為**南方松**，分佈於美國東南部各地。牠們是認出這個地區的好方法，因為牠們數量豐富、易於辨識且大多僅限於該國的這個部分。牠們通常很高，帶有蓬鬆外觀的松針叢。

text: Grass that is used in lawns in the southern US (colloquially known as [Bermuda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynodon_dactylon) and [St. Augustine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Augustine_grass) grasses) go dormant in the winter months. This causes the lawns to turn **beige or light brown in winter**; whereas grasses used in more northern areas of the US stay [much greener](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7HwppvMy4zQG2feq9) in winter.
text_zh: 美國南部用於草坪的草（俗稱[百慕達草](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cynodon_dactylon)和[聖奧古斯丁草](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Augustine_grass)）在冬季會進入休眠。這會導致草坪在**冬季變成米色或淺棕色**；而美國較北地區使用的草在冬季則會[保持翠綠得多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7HwppvMy4zQG2feq9)。

text: Great Basin Sagebrush ([Artemisia tridentata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artemisia_tridentata)) is a **short, shrubby blue-green bush** that is common in the interior western United States. It is most common in arid areas.
text_zh: 大盆地山艾樹 ([Artemisia tridentata](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artemisia_tridentata)) 是一種**矮小、呈灌木狀的藍綠色矮樹叢**，在美國西部內陸很常見。它在乾旱地區最為常見。

text: Saguaro cacti are most commonly shaped like** tall, straight tubes **with **several branches **extending from the main tube. They are most commonly found in southern Arizona, on the Sonoran border.
text_zh: 巨人柱仙人掌通常形狀像**高而直的圓柱**，主幹上延伸出**數個分枝**。它們最常分佈在亞利桑那州南部，位於索諾拉邊界一帶。

text: Extremely **tall conifer trees** ([Douglas firs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_fir)) with a dark brown bark, and dark green leaves, can most commonly be seen in Cascadia. Notably, they can also be found in northern California, Idaho and as far east as Montana.
Beware that they are also commonly found in British Columbia.
text_zh: 極其**高大的針葉樹**（[花旗松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_fir)），擁有深棕色樹皮與深綠色葉子，最常出現在卡斯卡底熱帶雨林。值得注意的是，它們也分佈在加州北部、愛達荷州，甚至向東延伸至蒙大拿州。
請注意，它們在英屬哥倫比亞省也很常見。

text: **Palm trees** are common in coastal areas of the Southeastern states, as well as the Desert Southwest region. Shown here is the Mexican Fan Palm, which is most common in California and along the Gulf Coast, but other palm tree types have a similar range.
text_zh: **棕櫚樹**常見於東南部各州的沿海地區，以及沙漠西南地區。此處顯示的是墨西哥扇椰子，最常見於加州及墨西哥灣沿岸，但其他種類的棕櫚樹也有類似的分布範圍。

text: Spanish moss, appearing as **greyish white drapes**, can sometimes be seen on trees in the Deep South.
text_zh: 有時可以在美國南部深處的樹上看到如**灰白色垂簾**般外觀的西班牙苔蘚。

text: Each state has their own highway shield. Some states have their own **unique, recognizable** highway shields that can be seen here.
text_zh: 每個州都有自己的公路盾牌標誌。有些州擁有獨特且**易於辨識**的公路盾牌，可以在這裡看到。

text: Most states have unique, distinct and learnable [Adopt-a-Highway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway) signs, which can be seen on the side of roads. A map of those can be seen here. Keep in mind, some states have slight variations in design.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 大多數州都有獨特、鮮明且易於學習的[認養公路](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adopt-a-Highway)標誌，這些標誌可以在道路旁看到。可以在這裡查看這些標誌的地圖。請記住，有些州的設計有些許差異。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Blue and yellow** shields are used for county roads, and can be seen in certain states in the US. Keep in mind, unique designs can be found in some counties in certain states. For more information, see [here](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads).
text_zh: **藍色和黃色**的盾牌用於郡道，可以在美國的特定州看到。請記住，某些州的特定郡中可以找到獨特的設計。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱[此處](https://geohints.com/countries/us/signs/countyRoads)。

text: Guardrails, signs, and signposts are commonly painted a **medium brown colour** in US National Parks, which are often located in the west. Guardrails that are painted brown can be made out of both [wood](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5) and metal. [Rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7) can also sometimes be seen in place of guardrails.
[Here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0) you can find a map showing where all US National Parks are located.
NOTE: There are occasional exceptions to this rule, so consider other clues before guessing in a National Park.
text_zh: 在美國國家公園中，護欄、標誌和路標通常漆成**中棕色**，而這些國家公園大多位於西部。漆成棕色的護欄可以由[木頭](https://goo.gl/maps/syWa2BkK99zBRmzv5)和金屬製成。有時也能看到[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/bU1rFbRpVUP1LzRD7)代替護欄。
[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_parks_of_the_United_States#/map/0)可以找到顯示所有美國國家公園位置的地圖。
注意：這項規則偶爾會有例外，因此在國家公園內盲猜之前，請先考慮其他線索。

text: These **rectangular raised pavement markers** are found in the south and west of the US and also in Massachusetts.
text_zh: 這些**長方形突起路標**常見於美國南部和西部，以及麻薩諸塞州。

text: **Snowplowable raised pavement markers** can only be found on highways in the eastern states shown in the image. They are built into the road and somewhat resemble the letter H.
text_zh: **除雪機專用突起路標**僅見於圖片中所示的東部各州高速公路上。它們內嵌於道路中，外形有點像英文字母 H。

text: Rectangular pavement markers **each on the side of the double lines** are commonly found in Georgia, Florida, Texas, and California. Other rectangular RPM states have the RPM between the double lines.
NOTE: Beware of similar patterns in left turn lanes.
text_zh: 位於雙黃線**兩側**的長方形路標常見於喬治亞州、佛羅里達州、德州和加州。其他長方形路標（RPM）州的 RPM 則位於雙黃線之間。
注意：請小心左轉車道中的類似圖樣。

text: Yellow lines with a noticeably **larger gap** in between them are most common in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Oregon.
NOTE: Wide middle lines can also rarely appear in other states, so consider other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 中間間隔**明顯較大**的黃線最常出現在德州、阿肯色州、路易斯安那州、密西西比州和奧勒岡州。
注意：寬中線在其他州也很少見，因此在猜測之前請先考慮其他線索。

text: **Texan roads** often have a grainy, ‘salt and pepper’-like road surface.
NOTE: [Similar pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/ChBAJda4PYN38dJ1A) can sometimes be seen in adjacent states such as New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Colorado.
text_zh: **德州道路**的表面通常帶有顆粒感，呈「鹽與胡椒」般的道路材質。
注意：[類似的路面](https://goo.gl/maps/ChBAJda4PYN38dJ1A)有時也能在鄰近的州看到，例如新墨西哥州、奧克拉荷馬州和科羅拉多州。

text: Some rural roads in the Upper Midwest use a similar road pavement to [Texas](https://goo.gl/maps/GeXiD3RdkjUkGMWr9). They will have a **grainy, ‘salt and pepper’-like road surface**, but will vary in colour. These roads are most common in the state of Illinois.
text_zh: 上中西部的一些鄉間道路採用了類似[德州](https://goo.gl/maps/GeXiD3RdkjUkGMWr9)的道路鋪面。它們會有**顆粒感、呈「鹽與胡椒」般的道路表面**，但顏色會有所不同。這種道路在伊利諾州最常見。

text: A **black stripe** can sometimes be seen in between the two yellow, middle road lines in California.
text_zh: 加州的兩條黃色中間道路標線之間，有時可以看到一條**黑色條紋**。

text: Some small roads in California** **and Kentucky **lack a middle yellow line**; instead only feature solid white lines on each side of the road.
NOTE: This can rarely be seen in other [states](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dJTjThBAHowKFxd59).
text_zh: 加州和肯塔基州的一些小路**缺乏中間黃線**；取而代之的是道路兩側僅有實心白線。
注意：這種情況在其他[州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dJTjThBAHowKFxd59)很少見。

text: Some roads and highways in the state of Kentucky use uniquely-shaped rumble strips that are **thin, relatively long recessed lines** on the very outside edges of the road.
text_zh: 肯塔基州的一些道路和高速公路採用了特殊形狀的減速震動線，這些線是位於道路最外側邊緣上的**較細、相對較長的凹槽線**。

text: Some roads in West Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, and Virginia use middle yellow lines that are thicker than [traditional](https://goo.gl/maps/sawqJcR8YeWq3Pzr6) yellow road lines.
NOTE: These are not present on all roads in these states, and can be found elsewhere so use this tip in conjunction with other clues.
text_zh: 西維吉尼亞州、馬里蘭州、德拉瓦州和維吉尼亞州的一些道路採用比[傳統](https://goo.gl/maps/sawqJcR8YeWq3Pzr6)黃色道路標線更粗的中間黃線。
注意：這些標線並非存在於這些州的所有道路上，且在其他地方也能找到，因此請將此技巧與其他線索結合使用。

text: **Concrete paving **on **regular roads** is much more common in Iowa than in other states.
Do not trust if it is a [bridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7cicwiNr6GfHErhF9), a [highway](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4h3ogNvAfu3HchU47), or it is in a [city](https://goo.gl/maps/5EneE9SWMHBwooov8).
text_zh: 在**一般道路**上使用**混凝土鋪面**在愛荷華州比其他州常見得多。
如果這是一座[橋樑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7cicwiNr6GfHErhF9)、[高速公路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4h3ogNvAfu3HchU47)，或是位於[城市](https://goo.gl/maps/5EneE9SWMHBwooov8)中，請勿盲目相信。

text: Utility poles in most of California have markings at the bottom of the pole that consist of **3 yellow stripes**. Modoc County and Lassen County in the Northeast of the state are the main exceptions.
This design can also be found in the city of [Grants Pass, Oregon](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NQuKzUpPAgSQFZos6).
text_zh: 加州大部分地區的電線桿底部都有由** 3 條黃色條紋**組成的標記。位於該州東北部的莫多克郡和拉森郡是主要的例外。
這種設計也可以在[奧勒岡州格蘭茨帕斯](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NQuKzUpPAgSQFZos6)市找到。

text: A rectangular **white** metal plate, with an orange rectangle and diamond, can be seen on most poles in Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan.
text_zh: 威斯康辛州和密西根州上半島的大多數電線桿上，都可以看到一個長方形的**白色**金屬牌，上面有一個橘色長方形和菱形。

text: PacificCorp pole markings are **thick, yellow, horizontal metal plates** with raised lettering or [black lettering](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pxJzZtogJE7MoRNy6). They can be found alone or with [multiple plates on one pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PYQjVQX1akDg5Wzh8). They are found in Oregon, eastern Idaho, Utah, and Wyoming, and less commonly in California and Washington.
text_zh: PacificCorp 的電線桿標記是**厚實、黃色的水平金屬板**，帶有浮雕字體或[黑色字體](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pxJzZtogJE7MoRNy6)。它們可以單獨出現，也可以[多個金屬板在同一根電線桿上](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PYQjVQX1akDg5Wzh8)。它們分佈在奧勒岡州、愛達荷州東部、猶他州和懷俄明州，在加州和華盛頓州則較少見。

text: This bollard is found in **Nevada**. It consists of a reflector on a thin stick. The reflector is a vertical rectangle that consists of a white field surrounded by a black outline.
text_zh: 這種路樁見於**內華達州**。它由細桿上的反光片組成。反光片是一個垂直的長方形，由周圍有黑色外框的白色區塊組成。

text: Bollards in Colorado and Wyoming often feature a dark metal post with a **white circular reflector**, but it is not fully on the top of the post; instead, **part of the post goes above the reflector**.
The **top** of the metal pole is sometimes painted [white or grey](https://maps.app.goo.gl/atZPypoYhE7vNKZk9), which is unique to Wyoming.
text_zh: 科羅拉多州和懷俄明州的護欄路樁通常具有帶有**白色圓形反光片**的深色金屬柱，但它並非完全位於柱子頂端；相反地，**柱子的一部分會高出反光片**。
金屬桿的**頂部**有時會漆成[白色或灰色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/atZPypoYhE7vNKZk9)，這是懷俄明州特有的特徵。

text: The state of Washington uses bollards that consist of a [white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JWXyCzVvNiAQ4NVV8) or [brown](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rCAieVzcSH1mrbST9) post with a white rectangle on the front of the bollard, and** two smaller white or silver squares **on the back of the bollard.
text_zh: 華盛頓州的路樁是由[白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JWXyCzVvNiAQ4NVV8)或[棕色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rCAieVzcSH1mrbST9)的柱子組成，路樁正面有一個白色長方形，背面則有**兩個較小的白色或銀色正方形**。

text: A bollard consisting of a **white square reflector** on top of a **black rectangle reflector** is unique to Utah.
text_zh: 由位於**黑色長方形反光板**上方的**白色正方形反光板**組成的路樁是猶他州特有的。

text: The most common type of roadside bollard in South Dakota and Montana features a **white diamond **reflector on top.
Montana tends to have [1 bolt](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rpu2S7wW7cq7UCXV9) on the reflector, while South Dakota tends to have 2.
NOTE: This is a common design and can be found in many states. Additionally, square bollards can be rotated on their side to look like diamonds. Use with caution.
text_zh: 南達科他州和蒙大拿州最常見的路邊路樁類型，其頂部皆有**白色菱形**反光板。
蒙大拿州的反光板通常有 [1 個螺栓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rpu2S7wW7cq7UCXV9)，而南達科他州通常有 2 個。
注意：這是一種常見的設計，可在許多州找到。此外，方形路樁可以側向旋轉看起來像菱形。請謹慎使用。

text: The most common type of bollard in Oregon has a very **long rectangular reflector** on top.
NOTE: Similar [bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DTmzW8bgvgTMnHhf7) exist in California.
text_zh: 俄勒岡州最常見的路樁類型頂部有一個非常**長的長方形反光板**。
注意：加州也有類似的[路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DTmzW8bgvgTMnHhf7)。

text: **Black colored** bollards with a **paddle shaped body** are common in Utah and Wyoming, and can also be found in Nebraska.
NOTE: A white reflector that is in the shape of a [square](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f4rVfZo5AxSLTS5k7) on this bollard design can only be found in Wyoming
text_zh: 具有**槳狀本體**的**黑色**路樁在猶他州和懷俄明州很常見，在內布拉斯加州也能找到。
注意：此路樁設計上呈[正方形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f4rVfZo5AxSLTS5k7)的白色反光板僅見於懷俄明州。

text: Bollards with **3 circular reflectors** attached to it are common in New Mexico.
text_zh: 附有 **3 個圓形反光板**的路樁在新墨西哥州很常見。

text: These simple **white** bollards with **black reflectors** are unique to Wisconsin.
text_zh: 這些附有**黑色反光板**的簡單**白色**路樁是威斯康辛州特有的。

text: Bollards where the reflector is shaped like a **square** are common in Utah, Arizona, and Idaho.
The Utah variant usually has [2 bolts](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXgYeFd7TBuuRywv6), the Arizona variant usually has one bolt, and Idaho can have both 2 bolts and one bolt.
NOTE: Diamond bollards can be rotated on their side to look like squares. Use with caution.
text_zh: 反光板形狀像**正方形**的路樁在猶他州、亞利桑那州和愛達荷州很常見。
猶他州的變體通常有 [2 個螺栓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zXgYeFd7TBuuRywv6)，亞利桑那州的變體通常有一個螺栓，愛達荷州則可能同時有 2 個螺栓或 1 個螺栓。
注意：菱形路樁可以側向旋轉看起來像正方形。請謹慎使用。

text: Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts use **small green and red rectangular signs** to mark the ends of bridges and guardrails.
NOTE: Not all bridges and guardrails in these states will have these markers.
text_zh: 緬因州、新罕布夏州和麻薩諸塞州使用**小型綠紅相間的長方形標誌**來標示橋樑和護欄的端點。
注意：這些州並非所有橋樑和護欄都有這些標示。

text: In Minnesota, these yellow signs with **vertical, black triangles** are placed before bridges at most major river crossings and at the beginnings and ends of guardrail sections on large highways.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州，這些帶有**垂直黑色三角形**的黃色標誌放置在多數主要河流交叉口的橋樑前，以及大型公路護欄區段的起點和終點。

text: Wisconsin and Missouri are the only two states that use a **lettering system** (A - ZZZ) for their county highways. Wisconsin signs typically have the word ‘county’ above the letter, while Missouri signs typically do not. The borders of the signs also vary slightly.
text_zh: 威斯康辛州和密蘇里州是僅有的兩個在其郡道使用**字母系統**（A - ZZZ）的州。威斯康辛州的標誌通常在字母上方有「county」一詞，而密蘇里州的標誌通常沒有。標誌的邊框也略有不同。

text: Speed signs in Oregon often simply have the word ‘**Speed**’ instead of the standard ‘Speed Limit’.
text_zh: 奧勒岡州的速限標誌通常只有「**Speed**」這個單字，而不是標準的「Speed Limit」。

text: **Yellow** or **red** bands can commonly be seen around signposts in Texas.
NOTE: Similar reflectors can sometimes be seen in other states, such as Hawaii.
text_zh: 在德州的標誌桿周圍常可以看到**黃色**或**紅色**帶狀標示。
注意：有時在其他州（例如夏威夷）也能看到類似的反光板。

text: A horizontal blue, red, or green sign can commonly be seen at the ends of driveways in Wisconsin and the Michigan peninsula. The house number is present, in addition to either the **town name** and or the **road name** (usually).
NOTE: Nearby states often use [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9), but typically lack any town or street name information and only feature numbers.
text_zh: 在威斯康辛州和密西根半島的車道盡頭，常可見到水平的藍色、紅色或綠色標誌。除了門牌號碼外，通常還會附上**城鎮名稱**和/或**道路名稱**。
注意：鄰近的州經常使用[類似的標示](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9)，但通常缺乏任何城鎮或街道名稱資訊，且僅有數字。

text: Signs attached to **two** **signposts** can be seen in Michigan, Ohio, Minnesota, and New York. Not all signs are attached to two signposts.
NOTE: Double signposts can also be seen in other states, but are not as common.
text_zh: 在密西根州、俄亥俄州、明尼蘇達州和紐約州可以看到附著在**兩根****標誌桿**上的標誌。並非所有標誌都附著在兩根標誌桿上。
注意：雙標誌桿在其他州也能看到，但沒那麼常見。

text: West Virginia sometimes features street signs with a symbol that resembles a **fraction** inside a **circle**.
text_zh: 西維吉尼亞州的街道標誌有時會帶有一個圖案，該圖案類似**圓圈**內的**分數**。

text: North Carolina commonly uses a style of street signs showing **street numbers** and **arrows** in addition to the street name.
NOTE: Other states occasionally feature street signs with similar designs, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 北卡羅萊納州常使用一種街道標誌風格，除了街道名稱外，還顯示**街道號碼**與**箭頭**。
注意：其他州偶爾也會出現類似設計的街道標誌，因此在猜測前請利用其他線索。

text: In Oklahoma, you can often find a green rectangular sign with **3 rows of numbers** attached to the back of stop signs at rural intersections.
text_zh: 在奧克拉荷馬州，你常能在鄉村交叉口的「停車」標誌背面找到綠色長方形標誌，上面有 **3 排數字**。

text: These green **ATV Route signs** are unique to Wisconsin.
text_zh: 這些綠色的 **ATV Route 標誌**是威斯康辛州特有的。

text: Rectangular **white** signs can sometimes be seen attached to signposts at intersections in Pennsylvania. On top, the number of the converging state route is written.
text_zh: 在賓州的交叉口，有時可以看到附在標誌桿上的長方形**白色**標誌。最上方寫著匯流州道的編號。

text: Rectangular **white** signs can sometimes be seen at intersections in Virginia.
text_zh: 在維吉尼亞州的交叉口，有時可以看到長方形**白色**標誌。

text: **White signs** attached to signposts can commonly be seen in North Carolina.
text_zh: 在北卡羅萊納州，常可見到附在標誌桿上的**白色標誌**。

text: **Black** street signs with white text can commonly be found at intersections in South Carolina.
text_zh: 在南卡羅萊納州的交叉口，常可找到配有白字的**黑色**街道標誌。

text: New York and Vermont have **small rectangular green signs **with three rows of horizontal numbers. The top row of numbers correlates to the highway or road number the sign is on. For example, the sign in the image is on road NY-345.

Signs for Vermont will almost always start with 0 on the second row. The second row in New York will start with a number which corresponds to a district of the NYSDOT ([link)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg) which will help with narrowing a region.
text_zh: 紐約州和佛蒙特州有帶三排水平數字的**小型長方形綠色標誌**。最上面一排數字對應標誌所在的公路或道路編號。例如，圖片中的標誌位於 NY-345 道路上。
佛蒙特州的標誌第二排幾乎總是從 0 開始。紐約州的第二排將從一個數字開始，該數字對應於 NYSDOT 的一個區劃（[連結](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ce/NYSDOT_regions_map.svg)），這將有助於縮小區域範圍。

text: In New Hampshire there will often be a **white metal sign** with the characters ‘**E-2**’ on it adjacent to the road, typically at either end of bridges.
text_zh: 在新罕布夏州，道路旁通常會有一個**白色金屬標誌**，上面帶有字元「**E-2**」，通常位於橋樑的兩端。

text: On some rural ‘stop’ signposts in Minnesota, a **black-and-white marker** is attached to the posts horizontally. The shape may vary slightly.
text_zh: 在明尼蘇達州的一些鄉村「停車」標誌桿上，水平附有一個**黑白標記**。形狀可能會略有不同。

text: These **white reflectors** on signposts are unique to Kansas. They are most commonly seen on ‘stop’ signs in rural areas.
text_zh: 標誌桿上的這些**白色反光板**是堪薩斯州特有的。它們最常出現在鄉村地區的「停車」標誌上。

text: In rural areas of Connecticut, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire, **short rock walls** are commonly visible adjacent to the road.
NOTE: These rock walls can be found rarely in adjacent states.
text_zh: 在康乃狄克州、羅德島州、麻薩諸塞州和新罕布夏州的鄉村地區，道路旁常見到**矮石牆**。
注意：這些石牆在鄰近的州很少見。

text: **Oil pumpjacks** are short, industrial-looking metal structures located at the surface of oil fields and are used to pump crude oil from the earth below. They are most common in western states, particularly in Texas, Eastern New Mexico, and North Dakota.
text_zh: **抽油機**是位於油田地表、外觀呈工業風的金屬結構，用於將地底下的原油抽取上來。牠們在西部各州最為常見，特別是在德州、新墨西哥州東部和北達科他州。

text: **Square guardrails** are the most dominant (but not the only) type of guardrail in the states of New York and Wyoming. They have a long bar across the top, with several square legs supporting them.
NOTE: These guardrails can be found, to a lesser extent, in some adjacent states.
text_zh: **方形護欄**是紐約州和懷俄明州最主要（但非唯一）的護欄類型。它們頂部有一根長橫桿，並由數個方形支柱支撐。
注意：這些護欄在某些鄰近州也能找到，但數量較少。

text: Streets in Utah and Idaho, particularly in urban areas, are often named by using a combination of a **number and cardinal direction** (i.e. ‘600 South.’)
NOTE: This style of street naming can be found rarely in other Western states.
text_zh: 猶他州和愛達荷州的街道，特別是在市區，經常使用**數字與方位**的組合來命名（例如「600 South」）。
注意：這種街道命名風格在其他西部各州很少見。

text: **Dark-coloured wooden fences** with several horizontal wooden supports are common in farming areas of central and southern Appalachia, stretching from Pennsylvania to Georgia.
NOTE: These types of fences can be found elsewhere to a lesser extent, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 帶有多個水平木質支撐的**深色木柵欄**在中南部阿帕拉契亞的農村地區很常見，從賓州一直延伸到喬治亞州。
注意：這類柵欄在其他地方較少見，因此在猜測前請使用其他線索。

text: Many large intersections in Michigan have stop lights and signs that **hang from wires** that stretch across the middle of the intersection. These markers are commonly in yellow boxes.
NOTE: These are not completely unique to Michigan, but are most commonly seen there.
text_zh: 密西根州許多大型交叉口都有紅綠燈和標誌，**懸掛在橫跨交叉口中段的電線上**。這些標記通常在黃色方框中。
注意：這並非密西根州獨有，但在那裡最常看到。

text: **Stilt houses** can sometimes be seen on the coast. These are especially common toward the south, and on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts.
text_zh: 有時在海岸可以見到**高腳屋**。這些在南部以及大西洋和墨西哥灣沿岸特別常見。

text: Similar in style to aforementioned stilt houses, houses with much shorter stilts are common in the western and central Gulf Coast. These houses typically feature short stilts made of concrete or wood (**1-3 feet off the ground**) and are primarily found in areas near the coast and any adjacent rivers.
text_zh: 風格與上述高腳屋相似，立柱矮得多的房屋在墨西哥灣沿岸西部和中部很常見。這些房屋通常採用由混凝土或木材製成的矮立柱（**離地面 1-3 英尺**），主要分佈在海岸附近及任何鄰近河流的地區。

text: Buildings with very **large, sloped roofs** are most common in the states of Oklahoma, Texas, and Louisiana. They can also be seen in neighbouring states to a lesser extent.
text_zh: 擁有非常**大且傾斜屋頂**的建築物最常出現在奧克拉荷馬州、德州和路易斯安那州。在鄰近各州也能見到，但較少見。

text: Houses in coastal New England often feature **shingle walls**, which are layered wood panels overlapping each other.
A similar style of panelling can also be [seen](https://goo.gl/maps/kvoJgHw9fLZTCAYy8), however, having a wider range than the one shown above.
text_zh: 新英格蘭海岸的房屋通常採用**木瓦外牆**，這是層層重疊的木板。
然而，類似風格的拼板也可以[看到](https://goo.gl/maps/kvoJgHw9fLZTCAYy8)，不過分佈範圍比上述的還要廣。

text: Older **three storey wooden houses**, also called ‘[stacked triplexes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-decker_(house)),’ are very common in urban areas of the Northeast. They are most prevalent in New York, Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts.
NOTE: These types of houses are also somewhat common in cities in [Atlantic Canada](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XKdZcqHCu2YhDXZp7).
text_zh: 較舊的**三層木造房屋**（也稱為「[疊層三拼屋](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-decker_(house))」）在東北部的都市地區非常普遍。它們在紐約州、康乃狄克州、羅德島州和麻薩諸塞州最為盛行。
注意：這類房屋在[大西洋加拿大](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XKdZcqHCu2YhDXZp7)的城市中也算常見。

text: Brownstone buildings are typically row houses or government buildings made out of various types of **brick** and **sandstone**. They are most commonly found in dense urban areas of the Northeast US, as well as Chicago.
text_zh: 褐砂石建築通常是由各種**磚塊**和**砂石**製成的連棟房屋或政府建築。它們最常出現在美國東北部的密集都會區以及芝加哥。

text: Buildings with **red metal rooftops** are most commonly found in the Mid-South and Southern Appalachia states of Virginia, West Virginia, Ohio, Kentucky, Tennessee, Arkansas, and North Carolina.
NOTE: These types of rooftops can be found in other areas, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 擁有**紅色金屬屋頂**的建築物最常出現在中南部和南阿帕拉契亞各州，包含維吉尼亞州、西維吉尼亞州、俄亥俄州、肯塔基州、田納西州、阿肯色州和北卡羅萊納州。
注意：這類屋頂也可能出現在其他地區，因此在猜測前請利用其他線索。

text: **Very narrow, one-storey** houses made out of wood are called ‘shotgun houses.’ They are most common in and around New Orleans (LA,) Houston (TX,) Louisville (KY,) and the state of Mississippi.
text_zh: 由木頭建造、**非常狹窄且僅有一層樓**的房屋被稱為「槍管屋（shotgun houses）」。它們最常出現在紐奧良（路易斯安那州）、休士頓（德州）、路易維爾（肯塔基州）及其周邊地區，以及密西西比州。

text: Pueblo Revival style houses are commonly seen in New Mexico. They are typically constructed of adobe or brick and concrete. They have **rounded edges** and **flat roofs**, and are usually sand-brown in colour.
NOTE: Pueblo style houses can also be seen in Arizona and Colorado to a lesser extent.
text_zh: 普韋布洛復興風格房屋在新墨西哥州很常見。它們通常由 adobe（土坏磚）或磚塊與混凝土建造。它們具有**圓潤的邊緣**和**平坦的屋頂**，通常呈沙褐色。
注意：普韋布洛風格的房屋在亞利桑那州和科羅拉多州也能見到，但較少見。

text: Spanish Colonial Revival Architecture can be categorised as buildings with **lightly-coloured stucco walls** and **red clay-tile roofs**. They can be found in the desert southwest states of California, Nevada, Arizona, and Texas. You can also find similar types of buildings in Florida and coastal Georgia.
text_zh: 西班牙殖民復興建築的特點是擁有**淺色 stucco 外牆**和**紅瓦屋頂**。它們可以在西南部沙漠各州（加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州和德州）找到。你在佛羅里達州和喬治亞州海岸也能找到類似類型的建築。

text: Houses and commercial buildings in the interior Western US are often made of lots of **dark wooden boards and timbers**. Buildings at high elevations also commonly have [metal roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9), to avoid snow build-up.
text_zh: 美國西部內陸的房屋和商業建築通常由大量**深色木板和木材**建成。高海拔地區的建築也普遍採用[金屬屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9)，以避免積雪。

text: **Alaska** is the largest state and the north-, west-, and easternmost state in the US.
A separate Plonk It guide to Alaska can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/alaska).
text_zh: **阿拉斯加州**是美國面積最大的州，也是美國最北、最西和最東的州。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/alaska)找到獨立的 Plonk It 阿拉斯加州指南。

text: **Hawaii** is the youngest state in the US and the only US state outside of North America.
A separate Plonk It guide to Hawaii can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/hawaii).
text_zh: **夏威夷州**是美國最年輕的州，也是北美洲以外唯一的美國州份。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/hawaii)找到獨立的 Plonk It 夏威夷州指南。

text: **Puerto Rico** is a Caribbean US territory with official Commonwealth status.
A separate Plonk It guide to Puerto Rico can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/puerto-rico).
text_zh: **波多黎各**是加勒比海的美國領地，具有官方的自由邦地位。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/puerto-rico)找到獨立的 Plonk It 波多黎各指南。

text: **American Samoa** is a South Pacific island group and an unorganised US territory.
A separate Plonk It guide to American Samoa can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/american-samoa).
text_zh: **美屬薩摩亞**是南太平洋群島，也是一個未合併的美國領地。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/american-samoa)找到獨立的 Plonk It 美屬薩摩亞指南。

text: **Guam** is an unincorporated territory of the US and the largest island in Micronesia.
A separate Plonk It guide to Guam can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/guam).
text_zh: **關島**是美國的未合併領地，也是密克羅尼西亞最大的島嶼。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/guam)找到獨立的 Plonk It 關島指南。

text: **Northern Mariana Islands** is a Northwest Pacific island chain and a Commonwealth US territory.
A separate Plonk It guide to Northern Mariana Islands can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/northern-mariana-islands).
text_zh: **北馬利安納群島**是西北太平洋島鏈，也是美國的自由邦領地。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/northern-mariana-islands)找到獨立的 Plonk It 北馬利安納群島指南。

text: The **United States Virgin Islands** is a Caribbean US territory and the only area of the US that drives on the left side of the road.
A separate Plonk It guide to the United States Virgin Islands can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/us-virgin-islands).
text_zh: **美屬維京群島**是加勒比海的美國領地，也是美國唯一靠道路左側駕駛的地區。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/us-virgin-islands)找到獨立的 Plonk It 美屬維京群島指南。

text: The **US Minor Outlying Islands** is a collective name for several small island US territories, with the Midway Atoll being the most relevant in Geoguessr.
A separate Plonk It guide to the US Minor Outlying Islands can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/us-minor-outlying-islands).
text_zh: **美國本土外小島嶼**是多個美國小型島嶼領地的統稱，其中中途島（Midway Atoll）在 GeoGuessr 中最為重要。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/us-minor-outlying-islands)找到獨立的 Plonk It 美國本土外小島嶼指南。

text: Deep South Florida, between the metropolitan areas of Ft. Myers and Miami, features **dense, jungle-like forests** that have few inhabitants. Roads through these areas are commonly very straight and long.
text_zh: 南佛羅里達深處，在麥爾茲堡（Ft. Myers）和邁阿密等大都會區之間，有著**人煙稀少的茂密叢林般森林**。穿過這些地區的道路通常非常筆直且漫長。

text: The Florida Keys are an archipelago of tropical islands west of Miami. The highway connecting the islands can be recognized by green, tropical vegetation on the sides of the usually single lane road. The soil is also **sandy white**.
Urban locations are also similar, but with many more planted palm trees and mowed grass being a common sight.
text_zh: 佛羅里達礁島群是邁阿密以西的一群熱帶島嶼。連接這些島嶼的公路可以透過通常為單線道道路兩側的綠色熱帶植被來辨識。土壤也是**沙白色**。
城鎮地點也很相似，但有更多種植的棕櫚樹，修剪整齊的草皮也很常見。

text: The area between the cities of Orlando and Lakeland in Florida sometimes feature **low**, **rolling hills.** Lakes and agricultural fields are also common in this area. This is the only main hilly area in central or southern Florida.
text_zh: 佛羅里達州奧蘭多和萊克蘭市之間的地區有時會出現**低矮**、**起伏的丘陵。**湖泊和農田在該地區也很常見。這是佛羅里達州中部或南部唯一的 主要丘陵區。

text: Southwestern Oklahoma features a small area of **rocky, shrubby peaks**. Some of the mountains are also covered in trees, and the rocks can have a pinkish red tint to them.
text_zh: 奧克拉荷馬州西南部有一小片**岩石林立、灌木叢生的山峰**。有些山脈也覆蓋著樹木，岩石可能帶有粉紅色調。

text: Central Colorado is home to a large **North-to-South oriented mountain ridge**. This divides the Rocky Mountains to the west and the Great Plains to the east.These mountains are adjacent to the major metropolitan areas of Boulder, Denver, and Colorado Springs.
text_zh: 科羅拉多州中部是大型**南北走向山脊**的所在地。這將西部的洛磯山脈和大平原分隔開來。這些山脈與波德、丹佛和科羅拉多泉等主要大都會區相鄰。

text: Along the New Mexico and or Texas border there is a ridge of **tall, dry peaks** known as the Guadalupe Mountains. In adjacent areas of both states, [smaller foothills](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9) of these mountains can be seen with relatively flat tops and shrubby foliage.
text_zh: 在新墨西哥州及／或德州的邊界沿線，有一道被稱為瓜達盧佩山脈（Guadalupe Mountains）的**高大乾旱山脊**。在兩州相鄰的地區，可以看到這些山脈[較小的山前丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9)，山頂相對平坦，並覆蓋著灌木植被。

text: The Black Hills, located in far Western South Dakota and far Eastern Wyoming, are a series of moderately tall mountains with large amounts of **conifer trees** and **rocky outcroppings**. The surrounding areas are typically much flatter with lesser tree cover.
NOTE: This area has a similar appearance to many areas within the Rocky Mountains, which lie further to the West.
text_zh: 黑山（The Black Hills）位於南達科他州最西部和懷俄明州最東部，是一系列中等高度的山脈，擁有大量的**針葉樹**和**岩石露頭**。周圍地區通常平坦得多，樹木覆蓋率較低。
注意：這個地區的外觀與進一步向西延伸的洛磯山脈中的許多地區相似。

text: As part of a promotional campaign, the TransAmerica Trail from Oregon to North Carolina was covered by a **Ford Bronco**. The car can be recognised by its unblurred black roof and red hood, and is mostly found on unpaved rural roads.
Looking [backwards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98), you will see two other Ford SUVs escorting the camera car.
text_zh: 作為宣傳活動的一部分，從奧勒岡州到北卡羅萊納州的跨美洲步道（TransAmerica Trail）是由一輛**福特野馬（Ford Bronco）**所拍攝的。這輛車可以透過其未模糊的黑色車頂和紅色引擎蓋來識別，主要出現在未鋪裝的鄉村道路上。
往[後方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98)看，你會看到另外兩輛護送相機車的 Ford 休旅車。

text: Interstate 19 in Arizona from Tucson to the Mexico border uses **kilometres** on the exit and distance signs. This is the only part of the country that uses kilometres instead of miles for highway signs.
NOTE: Speed limit signs in this area still use MPH instead of KPH.
text_zh: 亞利桑那州從土遜（Tucson）到墨西哥邊境的 19 州際公路（Interstate 19），其出口與距離標示使用的是 **公里**。這是全美唯一在高速公路標誌上使用公里而非英裡的地區。
注意：該地區的速限標誌仍然使用 MPH（英裡/小時）而非 KPH（公里/小時）。

text: Many bridges are used to connect the various neighbourhoods of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. These expansive, **steel bridges** are commonly painted **bright yellow**. Additionally, Pittsburgh is easy to identify because of it being flanked by 3 rivers and [steep bluffs](https://goo.gl/maps/c1aDMCziomL5iJ3F6) on all sides.
text_zh: 許多橋樑用於連接賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡的各個社區。這些寬廣的 **鋼製橋樑** 通常被漆成 **亮黃色**。此外，匹茲堡很容易辨認，因為它四周都被 3 條河流和[陡峭峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/c1aDMCziomL5iJ3F6)所環繞。

text: Row Houses and other buildings in San Francisco are often in the style of Victorian architecture, with many **bay windows, turrets, and ornate exterior details**. These homes are built close together and can be very colourful.
text_zh: 舊金山的連棟房屋和其他建築通常採用維多利亞式建築風格，帶有許多 **凸窗、小塔樓和華麗的外觀細節**。這些房屋建得很緊密，而且色彩可以非常豐富。

text: Neighbourhoods all around the city of New Orleans feature many **colourful, historic, shotgun-style houses.**
Buildings in central areas of New Orleans often feature colourful facades with second storey wrap-around balconies**.**
text_zh: 紐奧良全市各地的社區都有許多 **色彩繽紛、歷史悠久的槍管屋（shotgun-style houses）。**
紐奧良市中心地區的建築通常具有色彩繽紛的外牆以及二樓環繞式陽台**。**

text: Historical areas of Miami and Miami beach are home to many historical, **multi-storey art deco** buildings. These buildings are commonly painted in bright colours and are located near the coast.
text_zh: 邁阿密與邁阿密海灘的歷史街區擁有許多歷史悠久的 **多層裝飾藝術（art deco）** 建築。這些建築通常漆成明亮的顏色，且位於海岸附近。

text: The main island of Dry Tortugas National Park, west of Key West, can be identified by the **hexagonal brick structure** and the surrounding moat.

The Loggerhead Lighthouse, situated on the Loggerhead Key, has a brown top-half and a white bottom. The path on which the trekker walks on is also made of bright concrete, and many palm trees can be seen around the lighthouse.
text_zh: 位於基韋斯特（Key West）西側的乾龜群島國家公園（Dry Tortugas National Park）主島，可以透過 **六角形磚造結構** 以及周圍的護城河來辨識。
位於 Loggerhead Key 的 Loggerhead Lighthouse，其燈塔上半部為棕色，下半部為白色。拍攝用的徒步拍攝所行走的步道也是由明亮的混凝土製成，燈塔周圍可以看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Big Bend National Park is located along the Mexico border in Southwest Texas. It can be identified by its **dry, rocky peaks and shrubby foliage**. This park is adjacent to the Chihauhan desert, so plants such as yucca and prickly pear cactus are common.
text_zh: Big Bend National Park 位於美國德州西南部與墨西哥的邊界沿線。其特徵為**乾燥、多石的山峰與灌木叢生的植物**。這座公園鄰近奇瓦瓦沙漠（Chihuahuan Desert），因此絲蘭和刺梨仙人掌等植物相當常見。

text: Death Valley National Park can be easily recognized by the **dry, sandy, treeless mountains** that can be seen from the roads that go through the park. In Generation 3 coverage, the sky can look particularly [dusty](https://goo.gl/maps/aKvwrG5nAMKiyGhv6).
NOTE: Many smaller roads in Death Valley only have Generation 1 coverage.
text_zh: Death Valley National Park 可以透過穿過公園的道路上所看到的**乾燥、沙質、無樹木的山脈**輕易辨識。在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，天空看起來可能會特別[霧濛濛的](https://goo.gl/maps/aKvwrG5nAMKiyGhv6)。
注意：死谷（Death Valley）中的許多小路只有第 1 代街景覆蓋。

text: Along the Canadian border in Montana lies Glacier National Park. It is easily recognizable by its extremely tall and **steep mountain peaks**. Most coverage is also hazy and taken during summer.
NOTE: Other National Parks within the Rocky Mountain range of the US can have a similar appearance, so consider other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 位在蒙大拿州加拿大邊境沿線的是 Glacier National Park。它以極高且**陡峭的山峰**而容易被認出。大多數的街景覆蓋也呈現霧狀，且拍攝於夏季。
注意：美國洛磯山脈內的其它國家公園也可能呈現相似的外觀，因此在盲猜前請綜合考量其他線索。

text: Badlands National Park features these distinct, **sand-brown**, **eroded rock formations**. The formations may sometimes appear more rounded, and lighter in [colour](https://goo.gl/maps/KKcPZcwq8hCZoyNS6).
text_zh: Badlands National Park 的特色是這些獨特的、**沙棕色**的、**受侵蝕的岩層**。這些岩層有時看起來會更圓潤，[顏色](https://goo.gl/maps/KKcPZcwq8hCZoyNS6)也更淺。

text: Theodore Roosevelt National Park features similar, **sand-brown**, eroded rock formations to Badlands National Park. The rock formations in this park tend to have more trees on them. Additionally, almost all coverage has **fall colours** visible.
NOTE: Similar formations can be seen in far eastern Montana as well.
text_zh: Theodore Roosevelt National Park 的特色是擁有與 Badlands National Park 相似的、**沙棕色**的受侵蝕岩層。這個公園裡的岩層往往長有較多樹木。此外，幾乎所有的**街景覆蓋**都能看見秋天色彩。
注意：在蒙大拿州極東部也能看到類似的岩層。

text: In far Northeastern Wyoming lies Devil’s Tower, which is a **very tall, standalone butte** protruding from the surrounding land. This can sometimes be seen from many miles away because of the lack of nearby mountains.
text_zh: 位於懷俄明州極東北部的 Devil’s Tower，是一座從周圍土地拔地而起的**非常高且獨立的孤峰**。由於附近缺乏山脈，這座孤峰有時從數英里外就能看見。

text: Pictured here is a group of **gas stations** and **convenience store** chains that operate **in the United States**, but **not in Canada**. This is not a comprehensive list, but some of the most common American-only chains.
text_zh: 這裡圖示的是一組**美國**有營業但**加拿大**沒有的**加油站**與**便利商店**連鎖店。這並非完整清單，但列出了一些最常見的美國獨有連鎖店。

text: Pictured here is a group of **restaurant chains** that operate **in the United States**, but **not in Canada** (Chick-fil-A is the only exception with a few locations in the [Toronto area](https://goo.gl/maps/QyrJsJaecJSyupZSA)). This is not a comprehensive list, but some of the most common American-only chains.
text_zh: 這裡圖示的是一組**美國**有營業但**加拿大**沒有的**餐廳連鎖店**（Chick-fil-A 是唯一的例外，在 [Toronto 地區](https://goo.gl/maps/QyrJsJaecJSyupZSA)有幾家分店）。這並非完整清單，但列出了一些最常見的美國獨有連鎖店。

text: ‘**Shoprite**’ is a regional supermarket chain that has locations in 6 states in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region of the US; Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland.
text_zh: 「**Shoprite**」是一個區域性超級市場連鎖店，在美國東北部和中大西洋地區的 6 個州設有分店：康乃狄克州、紐約州、紐澤西州、賓夕法尼亞州、德拉瓦州和馬里蘭州。

text: ‘**Hy-Vee**’ is a supermarket that is common primarily in the Upper Midwest states of Iowa, Minnesota, Wisconsin, and Illinois.
text_zh: 「**Hy-Vee**」是一家主要在中西部北部各州（愛荷華州、明尼蘇達州、威斯康辛州和伊利諾州）常見的超級市場。

text: The supermarket chain ‘**Piggly** Wiggly’ is found mostly in the Southeast, as well as the state of Wisconsin.
text_zh: 超級市場連鎖店「**Piggly** Wiggly」主要分佈在東南部以及威斯康辛州。

text: ‘**H-E-B**’ is a supermarket that is only located in the state of Texas. Most H-E-B stores are in large cities.
text_zh: 「**H-E-B**」是一家僅分佈在德州的超級市場。大部分 H-E-B 門市都位於大城市中。

text: ‘**Publix**’ is a regional supermarket chain that has locations primarily in Florida and adjacent areas of the Deep South.
text_zh: 「**Publix**」是一家區域性超級市場連鎖店，分店主要位於佛羅里達州以及美國深南部的鄰近地區。

text: The restaurant chain ‘**Waffle House**’ is a regional chain that is primarily found in the Southern and Southeast US. Some Midwest and Mid-Atlantic states have some locations. Georgia, by far, is the state with the most Waffle House locations.
text_zh: 餐廳連鎖店「**Waffle House**」是一家主要分佈在美國南部和東南部的區域性連鎖店。一些中西部和中大西洋地區的州也有部分分店。喬治亞州無疑是擁有最多 Waffle House 分店的州。

text: ‘[**Carl’s Jr.**](https://goo.gl/maps/jf4j4Yvu79sm7J6dA)’ and ‘[**Hardee’s**](https://goo.gl/maps/YQ8tVKSFnYHHocFCA)’ are fast food restaurants that are operated by the same company and have a similar logo and colour scheme. However, Carl’s Jr. locations are all located on the West Coast and Southwest US, while Hardee’s are found in the central and Eastern areas of the country. Two states, Wyoming and Oklahoma, have both kinds of restaurants present.
text_zh: 「[**Carl’s Jr.**](https://goo.gl/maps/jf4j4Yvu79sm7J6dA)」與「[**Hardee’s**](https://goo.gl/maps/YQ8tVKSFnYHHocFCA)」是由同一家公司經營的速食餐廳，並擁有相似的標誌與配色方案。然而，Carl’s Jr. 的分店全都位於美國西海岸和西南部，而 Hardee’s 則分佈在該國的中部和東部地區。有兩個州（懷俄明州和奧克拉荷馬州）同時存在這兩種餐廳。

text: ‘**Zaxby’s**,’ a fast-food chicken chain, is another restaurant that is most common in the Southeast US. There are several pockets outside the Southeast that have locations, such as Utah and Montana. Like Waffle House, Georgia has the highest number of locations.
text_zh: 「**Zaxby’s**」是一家連鎖炸雞速食店，是另一家在美國東南部最常見的餐廳。在東南部以外也有幾個零星的分店據點，例如猶他州和蒙大拿州。就像 Waffle House 一樣，喬治亞州擁有最高的分店數量。

text: ‘**Whataburger**’ is a hamburger restaurant with locations across the South Central US. The State that is home to the most locations, by far, is Texas.
text_zh: 「**Whataburger**」是一家漢堡餐廳，在美國中南部各地設有分店。擁有最多分店的州毫無疑問是德州。

text: ‘**Pizza Ranch**’ is a restaurant chain that is found in the middle of the country. Iowa and Minnesota have the highest number of locations.
text_zh: 「**Pizza Ranch**」是一家分佈在該國中部的連鎖餐廳。愛荷華州和明尼蘇達州擁有最高的分店數量。

text: ‘**Tim Hortons**’ is known for being the most popular restaurant chain in [Canada](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oZuj9b6LQuQL4PRg8). However, there are also many locations in the United States. They are primarily located in states adjacent to the Canadian provinces of Ontario and Québec, with a few locations also in Texas and Georgia.
text_zh: 「**Tim Hortons**」以[加拿大](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oZuj9b6LQuQL4PRg8)最受歡迎的餐廳連鎖店而聞名。然而，它在美國也有許多分店。它們主要位於與加拿大安大略省和魁北克省相鄰的州，在德州和喬治亞州也有少數分店。

text: ‘**In-N-Out Burger**’ is a regional fast food chain located primarily in the Southwest US. Around two thirds of all locations are located in California.
text_zh: 「**In-N-Out Burger**」是一家主要位於美國西南部的區域性速食連鎖店。大約三分之二的分店都位於加州。

text: ‘**WaWa**’ is a regional gas station and convenience store chain with locations in the Mid-Atlantic states and Florida. New Jersey and the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania area have the highest density of locations.
text_zh: 「**WaWa**」是一家區域性加油站兼便利商店連鎖店，分店位於中大西洋各州以及佛羅里達州。紐澤西州以及賓夕法尼亞州費城地區的分店密度最高。

text: Another regional gas station and convenience store chain in the Eastern US is called ‘**Sheetz**’. Most of their locations are in the Mid-Atlantic and Central Appalachian areas of the US. Pennsylvania has the highest number of locations.
text_zh: 美國東部的另一家區域性加油站兼便利商店連鎖店名為「**Sheetz**」。他們的大多數分店都位於美國的中大西洋和阿巴拉契亞中部地區。賓夕法尼亞州擁有最高的分店數量。

text: ‘**Kwik Trip**’ is a chain of gas stations and convenience stores that are located in the Upper Midwest states of Wisconsin and Minnesota. In Iowa, these stores are called ‘[**Kwik Star**](https://goo.gl/maps/6MgdfZ1ey134z9Yi6)’ and have similar branding. Some stores may also have the name ‘[Stop-N-Go](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KXXGnVPs4aBiXU39A)’.
text_zh: 「**Kwik Trip**」是一個加油站與便利商店連鎖店，分店位於中西部北部的威斯康辛州和明尼蘇達州。在愛荷華州，這些商店被稱為「[**Kwik Star**](https://goo.gl/maps/6MgdfZ1ey134z9Yi6)」並擁有相似的品牌標識。有些商店也可能名為「[Stop-N-Go](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KXXGnVPs4aBiXU39A)」。

text: ‘**Kum & Go**’ is a regional gas station chain based out of the state of Iowa. They also have pockets of locations in the Ozarks, Colorado, Wyoming, and North Dakota.
text_zh: 「**Kum & Go**」是一家總部位於愛荷華州的區域性加油站連鎖店。他們在歐札克地區（Ozarks）、科羅拉多州、懷俄明州和北達科他州也有零星的分店據點。

text: ‘**Casey’s**’ is a popular gas station and convenience store chain that is found in the Midwest, Plains, and parts of the Mid-South. Illinois, Iowa, and Missouri have the highest number of locations.
text_zh: 「**Casey’s**」是一家受歡迎的加油站和便利商店連鎖店，分店見於中西部、平原地區以及中南部的一部分地區。伊利諾州、愛荷華州和密蘇里州擁有最高的分店數量。

text: ‘**Buc-ee’s**’ is a small chain of oversized gas stations located primarily in the state of Texas. These stores feature multiple rows of gas pumps, and a very large convenience store building.
NOTE: Some other nearby states have Buc-ee’s locations, but they are quite rare outside of Texas.
text_zh: 「**Buc-ee’s**」是一家大型加油站的小型連鎖店，主要位於德州。這些商店特色是擁有好幾排加油機，以及非常大型的便利商店建築。
注意：其他一些鄰近的州也有 Buc-ee’s 的分店，但在德州以外相當罕見。
